messages.subject: calculating meth.diff
parts:
Hi,

Thank you for the great tool. I am new in methylkit, so sorry for the naive question. 

I was wondering how methylkit calculates meth.diff? I have simulated dataset consist of five samples in case (b,b1,b2,b3,b4) and control (a,a1,a2,a3,a4) groups across ca. 1.35 million sites, of which some were designed to have a methylation change. methylkit identifies some of the sites as significantly diff meth while they are supposed no to be. For example: 

Chr       start      end    strand  pvalue  qvalue meth.diff

chr17 58563141 58563141 * 6.42E-18 6.01E-15 -29.0351

The beta values for the samples are as follow:

 a    0

a1    0
a2    0
a3    0.96
a4    0.56
b    0
b1    0
b2    0.01
b3    0.47
b4    0

when I calculate their mean methylation differences manually, I found meth.diff= -20%
